header: Disabling Amazon Cognito authentication for OpenSearch Dashboards
content:
Use the following procedure to disable Amazon Cognito authentication for Dashboards.
Disabling Amazon Cognito authentication for OpenSearch Dashboards
1411
Amazon OpenSearch Service
Developer Guide
To disable Amazon Cognito authentication for Dashboards (console)
1.
Open the Amazon OpenSearch Service console.
2.
Under Domains, choose the domain you want to conﬁgure.
3.
Choose Actions, Edit security conﬁguration.
4.
Deselect Enable Amazon Cognito authentication.
5.
Choose Save changes.
Important
If you no longer need the Amazon Cognito user pool and identity pool, delete them.
Otherwise, you continue to incur charges.
